epics.title: Unify Datastore Engine Across Runtime and Tests
epics.jtbd: When using the application, I want the system to be tested against the exact same database engine used in production, so that runtime errors from datastore incompatibilities are prevented.
requirements: R1: The runtime contract explicitly declares PostgreSQL as the datastore.
R2: The test suite and application configuration run against PostgreSQL, removing any H2 dependency.

slices.title: Patch runtime artifacts and test suite for PostgreSQL parity
slices.jtbd: When implementing the datastore alignment for this epic, I want to remove H2 and configure the tests to use PostgreSQL, so that runtime incompatibilities are caught during the build phase.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application test suite is executed
When the database is initialized
Then it provisions and runs against a PostgreSQL engine instead of H2
Given the project source code
When the runtime contract and configurations are inspected
Then they all explicitly specify and depend on PostgreSQL
